name: Coconut Tree
description: Own a fully grown, organically nurtured coconut tree in the rich, fertile soils of Karur, Tamil Nadu — without needing to farm it yourself. Your tree is carefully selected from the healthiest 500 out of 3,000 naturally grown trees on the farm. Grown Naturally With Care Zero chemicals Soil mulched naturally Goats roam freely, acting as weed removers and natural manure providers Native bees enhance pollination and farm biodiversity
whoIsItFor: Lovers of fresh coconut and homemade coconut oil. Health-conscious individuals seeking chemical-free produce. Anyone interested in supporting real organic farming. Gifting with purpose and personalization
whatYouGet: A 650 sq ft real farm plot, fully maintained for one season. Transparent photo/video updates of your exact plot. Organic crops grown naturally, using mulching bioculture, and native methods. End-of-season harvest delivered to your doorstep. Optional farm visit for families and kids who want to experience real farming
howToTrustItsOrganic: We send regular updates and photos so you can watch your fruit grow on your very own tree  - no worries, no guesswork. Farmmily was born to deliver genuinely organic food directly to those who value it, not just  sell it in markets. For over 13 years, we’ve followed sustainable, natural farming, because  organic food is precious, limited, and never meant to be commercialised. With full transparency, we bring you the true taste of nature — grown just for you
funFact: Every part of the coconut tree is useful, it's called the 'Tree of Life' for a reason!

faqs.question: I may not want the full harvest every year, can I get other fruits instead?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can sell the extra coconuts to Farmmily. You'll earn credits to redeem on mangoes, other organic products, or even farm experiences.

faqs.question: What if my coconut tree doesn't produce well this year?
faqs.answer: You can renew your lease or choose another tree.

faqs.question: How do I know the coconuts are really from my tree?
faqs.answer: You get photo/video updates tracking your tree — from flowering to harvest. 100% transparency.

faqs.question: How can I trust Farmmily's organic farming claims?
faqs.answer: No chemicals. No shortcuts. Our goats weed naturally, soils are mulched, and native bees thrive. You’ll see the difference.

name: Imam Pasand Mango Tree
description: Own a Premium Alphonso Mango Tree Claim one of only 250 handpicked, fully grown Alphonso mango trees-organically nurtured in the rich, fertile soil of Namakkal, Tamil Nadu. Out of 1,000+ trees, these are the top performers, selected using real harvest data for their yield, health, and fruit quality. Enjoy your own piece of nature and the sweetest returns this season.
whoIsItFor: Lovers of the rare, royal, and richly aromatic Imam Pasand mango. People who value organic, chemical-free produce. Anyone looking for an exclusive farm-to-table experience

funFact: Imam Pasand is known as the “King's Mango”, once grown only for royals. With its silky texture, floral aroma, and melt-in-the-mouth sweetness, it's one of the rarest and most premium mango varieties in India.

faqs.question: I may not need the full harvest — what can I do?
faqs.answer: You can sell your extra 30-35 kg mangoes back to Farmmily. We share them with local farmers at fair prices, and you earn Farmmily credits to use on other organic goodies.

faqs.question: What if my Imam Pasand tree doesn’t bear fruit this year?
faqs.answer: If your tree doesn’t flower by March, we’ll replace it with a high-performing tree from our farm. No stress — just real farming with care.

faqs.question: How do I know the fruits are really from my tree?
faqs.answer: You’ll receive regular photo and video updates from flowering to harvest. You can literally watch your fruits grow — 100% transparent.

faqs.question: How do I trust Farmmily’s organic practices?
faqs.answer: We don’t just say “organic” — we show it. No shortcuts. No chemicals. Only natural care. Your support inspires more farmers to go organic.
